objective: Accessibility Baseline：heading 结构审计、focus 基线（focus-visible/无 trap）、WCAG AA contrast 机械审计+最小 token 修正、minimal ARIA、reduced-motion contract、modal focus contract、semantic announcements、focus/selected/status 区分；NO_TOPOLOGY_CHANGE

owner_tightening.dp49_heading_follows_structure: 遵守：HEADING_LEVEL_FOLLOWS_DOCUMENT_STRUCTURE_NOT_VISUAL_TEXT_ROLE——审计真实页面结构（h2 店铺/h3 会话/AI建议/平台接入）；不强制每页 h1、不全用 div；text roles 不永久锁 heading level
owner_tightening.dp50_native_tab_order_visible_focus: 遵守：NATIVE_TAB_ORDER_VISIBLE_FOCUS_NO_KEYBOARD_TRAPS——真实交互均 native button；无 positive tabindex（测试负例）；focus-visible 覆盖 .fs-action/.btn/.shop-button/.mode-btn；不重复实现 native Enter/Space
owner_tightening.dp51_wcag_aa_contrast: 遵守：WCAG_AA_CONTRAST_BASELINE——mechanical contrast audit（text 4.5:1、UI boundary/focus 3:1）；最小 semantic-token 修正：muted #8c959f->#65717c（4.99/4.69）、border #d8dee4->#87919e（3.19/3.00）、focus outline->primary、selected border->primary；status 色全部 >=4.5；视觉变化已记录
owner_tightening.dp52_native_semantics_minimal_aria: 遵守：NATIVE_SEMANTICS_FIRST_MINIMAL_ARIA——native HTML 优先；ARIA 仅补 native 无法表达（alert/status/dialog/nav）；无 role=button on div/重复 aria-label/ARIA spam（测试负例）
owner_tightening.dp53_reduced_motion_requirement: 遵守：PREFERS_REDUCED_MOTION_IS_A_DESIGN_SYSTEM_REQUIREMENT——当前无 motion 不强制 selector；contract 确定，未来非必要 motion 必须尊重 reduced-motion
owner_tightening.dp54_modal_focus_contract: 遵守：MODAL_FOCUS_CONTRACT_REQUIRED_IMPLEMENTATION_AT_FIRST_REAL_CONSUMER——initial focus/contained tab/Escape/return focus 确立为 contract；dialog 无 consumer 不提前造 framework；overlay-click-close 继续 DEFER；不依赖 FastWork reference evidence
owner_tightening.dp55_semantic_announcements: 遵守：SEMANTIC_EVENT_ANNOUNCEMENTS_NOT_RAW_UPDATE_STREAMS——error=assertive（alert）/loading=polite（status）；无 raw update-stream announcement（测试负例）
owner_tightening.dp56_focus_selection_status_distinct: 遵守：FOCUS_SELECTION_AND_STATUS_ARE_VISUALLY_DISTINCT——focus=outline（primary）、selected=fill+border（primary on bg-selected）、status=color+text；三信号可区分
owner_tightening.accessible_name_audit: 遵守：interactive accessible-name audit（优先可见文字；无 icon-only 无名称控件；无重复/误导 aria-label、duplicate IDs、ARIA sanity）；Phase 4 页面 a11y 随真实功能验收
owner_tightening.loading_signal: 遵守：Loading「…」不作为唯一 accessible signal；有意义状态文字+status semantics 为 a11y source；未强行加 spinner
owner_tightening.error_label_note: 遵守：workspace error「错误:」标签不作为本任务 defect，继续 copy/design polish future note
owner_tightening.dialog_focus_reclassify: 遵守：SHEEP-029 focus DEFER 重新分类——focus contract 由本单元决定，implementation 在首个真实 modal consumer；overlay-click 等继续 DEFER
owner_tightening.visual_evidence: 遵守：A11y/Focus Gallery（focus-visible autofocus、selected vs focus vs status、loading/error announcements）+ current workbench；静态截图不足以证明 focus，故 Gallery 用 autofocus 展示实际 focus ring
owner_tightening.automated_guard: 遵守：renderer-a11y-baseline.test.ts 锁 a11y invariants（contrast 计算/focus-visible/无 tabindex/native heading/ARIA sanity/信号区分）；未堆 ARIA 凑测试；未引入大型 scanner 依赖
owner_tightening.no_topology_change: 遵守：NO_TOPOLOGY_CHANGE；a11y 属性/heading/focus/必要 contrast token 最小调整；未重做页面/Conversation IA/Store navigation/AI placement
